API access starts at $165 a user

How do you switch from Alchemer to Formester?

Three steps, and your seat count stops mattering.

Export your response data

In Alchemer, open the survey's Results and export to CSV or Excel. If you are on Full Access and rely on SPSS exports, take those while the licence is still active.

2

Rebuild the survey with AI

Paste your question list into Formester's AI generator or describe the survey in a sentence. It drafts the questions, pages, and design in about half a minute, then you adjust wording and branding.

Input options: plain prompt, pasted question list, or PDF upload.

3

Move your links and integrations

Swap the Alchemer distribution link for Formester's, reconnect HubSpot or Slack, and send one test response before you retire the old survey.

Worth noting: seats stop being a line item once you move.

Honest comparison

When is Alchemer still the better choice?

Formester is not the answer for every team. Four cases where Alchemer is the better call.

Certified compliance gates the purchase

Alchemer holds the certificate stack regulated procurement asks for.

  • SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, CCPA, and FERPA
  • HIPAA support, arranged as a business associate agreement through a customer success manager
  • Formester holds GDPR, UK GDPR, and CCPA, and is not SOC 2 or ISO 27001 certified

Choose Alchemer when a compliance review gates the purchase

You do real research, not just forms

Full Access carries analysis tooling a form builder does not attempt.

  • Conjoint, MaxDiff, TURF, card sort, and image heatmaps
  • SPSS export, crosstabs, R scripts, and open-text analysis
  • Formester ships summaries and drop-off analysis, not statistical modelling

Choose Alchemer for methodology-led research

You need respondents, not just a survey

Alchemer sells managed panel services alongside the platform.

  • A full-service panel team, with 100 million-plus respondents across more than 100 countries
  • Census-balanced invites and a data quarantine tool for unusable responses
  • Formester collects responses from audiences you already have

Choose Alchemer when you need to buy a sample

Field teams collect offline

Offline and kiosk modes ship from the Professional plan.

  • Offline mode and kiosk mode for events, field research, and in-store capture
  • Native iOS and Android SDKs through their Digital product
  • Formester does not advertise an offline collection mode

Choose Alchemer for offline and kiosk data collection

Privacy and data ownership

Who owns your form data?

You do. Everything moving through your forms is Customer Data: the prompts you type, the structures the AI drafts, and every response someone submits. Section 4.4 of our Data Processing Addendum bars Formester from using any of it to train AI models, run advertising, or feed analytics and marketing. The Google Gemini integration that drafts forms works inside the same boundary.

Responses travel over TLS, sit encrypted at rest, and payment data carries an extra AES-256 layer through Stripe. Formester is GDPR, UK GDPR, and CCPA compliant. We are not SOC 2, ISO 27001, or HIPAA certified, and the security page says exactly that instead of hinting otherwise. Compensating controls are in place: encryption in transit and at rest, annual third-party penetration testing, enforced 2FA, and encrypted backups.

DPA §4.4 · January 2026
"Formester shall not use Customer Data for purposes of analytics, advertising, marketing, or training of artificial intelligence or machine learning models, except as strictly necessary to provide the Services."

Formester Data Processing Addendum, effective January 2026.
